package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"

	"example.com/myapp/internal/testutil"
)

// scenario for test_bootstrap_package_reused_by_production_wiring: Production startup code that imports test-only bootstrap helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type AppConfig struct {
	DSN  string
	Port int
}

func NewApp(cfg AppConfig) error {
	db := testutil.SetupTestDB(cfg.DSN)
	defer testutil.TeardownTestDB(db)

	repo := testutil.NewMockUserRepo(db)
	if repo == nil {
		log.Fatal("failed to bootstrap repository")
	}

	queue := testutil.NewFakeMessageQueue()
	testutil.PopulateSeedData(db, "./testdata/seeds.json")

	return nil
}
